findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_strategy" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "estimate_swap_cost" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Estimate the friction cost (in bps) of swapping a bot in a fund. Use this before calling swap_bot_in_fund to understand the cost of winding down the old bot's p…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog, read_feed, read_wire, get_replies, get_feed_identity · Private data: submit_strategy, get_strategy_report, deactivate_fund, close_fund, get_public_fund_page, get_vault_status, get_vault_history, stop_fund_copy · Public sink: submit_strategy, post_fund_note, read_feed, like_post, reply_to_post, get_replies, get_feed_identity · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, remove_bot_from_fund, swap_bot_in_fund, run_fund_historical_test, set_manager_profile, delete_formation, run_ai_manager, reply_to_post, delete_reply, get_feed_identity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog, read_feed, read_wire, get_replies, get_feed_identity · Private data: submit_strategy, get_strategy_report, deactivate_fund, close_fund, get_public_fund_page, get_vault_status, get_vault_history, stop_fund_copy · Public sink: submit_strategy, post_fund_note, read_feed, like_post, reply_to_post, get_replies, get_feed_identity · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, remove_bot_from_fund, swap_bot_in_fund, run_fund_historical_test, set_manager_profile, delete_formation, run_ai_manager, reply_to_post, delete_reply, get_feed_identity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
